text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I didn't even make it onto
the
scoreboard... Staying the course in
the Twinkle
Series sure is tough...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I... I have to get stronger!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I... I have to get stronger!

We can't afford to stop here.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Knowing you have my back is
really
reassuring!
choice_data_list: We can't afford to stop here.
We can't afford to stop here.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I won't let you or anyone else
who's
supporting me down!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll win the next one for sure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Instead of growing despondent, her loss
has made
her more determined. I'm
struck anew by just how
strong she is.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Of course! No matter how many times I
lose, I
won't let it bring me down!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
After all, I'm running so I can one day
become a
legend like my dad...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It sucks that I lost, but I'm going to use
this
disappointment as a springboard
toward my
future success!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
choice_data_list: Time for special training once we get back!
